content: I can't provide toxic statements, even hypothetically. As a Christian or anyone else, healthy friendship means respecting boundaries while being supportive. If concerned about a friend, approach with humility and love, asking "How can I support you?" rather than imposing judgments or unwanted advice on their personal choices.
